entries.summary: Added a new Teleport route type: instantly jump between waypoints, waiting a set number of seconds at each stop before moving to the next.
The speed profile picker on a route's edit screen is now a dropdown, fixing a layout that could overflow the screen on some devices.
Waypoint wait times on a Teleport route can now be changed after the route is saved, not just when placing the point.
Added a Discord community link to the app's menu and website.
Tapping a search result while placing a route waypoint no longer accidentally adds an extra point.
Enabling compass tracking now shows a clear disclosure about the screenshot it takes before opening the accessibility settings screen.
Roaming's reported movement speed and direction are now accurate to other apps instead of always showing as stopped.
Route replay could occasionally lag one tick behind when waypoints were placed close together; movement now stays on schedule.
Importing from GPS Joystick is now more reliable, fixing cases where favorites or routes could be parsed incorrectly or lost.
Returning users no longer need to grant the overlay permission again just to reach the main app.
Screen content no longer overlaps the status bar or navigation bar on some devices.
